title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of the Spyglass platform, empowering all users with advanced tools to gain deeper insights.

title: Flexible File Management in the Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, remove, and download your files and images, with new options to customize their visual display directly within the editor.

title: Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand new public roadmap to see what we've recently shipped, what's next on our immediate horizon, and our exciting plans for the future.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience effortless teamwork in our editor with enhanced real-time indicators that ensure you always stay in sync and informed.

summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with your network, making every valuable item easily accessible.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights in Your Knowledge Map

summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information within your knowledge base by applying powerful filters and saving your tailored search results as personalized collections.

title: Smarter Content Previews
summary: Visualize and interact with your connected notes in powerful new ways, offering dynamic previews and flexible layouts to perfectly match your thinking.

title: Revitalized Themes and Fresh Styles
